headline: Six Fronts Intensify as Bases Change Hands
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the tempo has risen sharply on a half‑dozen sectors while the remainder of the map remains largely static. Weathered Expanse continues to dominate the casualty ledger: 24‑hour ownership flips have climbed to 57 from 55, Colonial losses now stand at 6,953 and Warden losses at 10,582, with fresh enlistments rising to 358. Callahans Passage has added five more captures, lifting its daily total to 25; the sector records 9,195 Colonial and 10,893 Warden dead and 726 new troops. Fisherman’s Row has become the newest hotspot, its flips more than doubling to 27 centred on Oceanwatch, Hangman’s Court and surrounding posts, while casualties reach 384 Colonial and 521 Warden and enlistments climb to 158. Stlican Shelf’s activity has risen to 15 flips, pushing 24‑hour losses to 2,819 Colonial and 3,008 Warden with 363 recruits. Mooring County steadies at ten flips, casualties easing to 6,941 Colonial and 8,260 Warden and enlistments falling to 706. Stema Landing, previously quiet, now shows eight flips and modest losses of 17 Colonial and 6 Warden with 57 enlistees. All other regions report no ownership changes, indicating the fighting remains concentrated on these six fronts.
